title: Senate Panel Votes to Hold Fauci in Contempt of Congress
summary: Dr. Anthony Fauci had refused to answer questions at a hearing last week, invoking the Fifth Amendment. Republicans argued he wasn’t entitled to that protection because he had a presidential pardon.
